rows.note: This is the all-purpose word when the exact type of flute is clear from context.

example.english: I learned to play the flute when I was young.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hok6 gwo3 ceoi1 dek6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the Western concert flute rather than a recorder or other flute.

example.english: The orchestra is recruiting people who can play the flute.
example.traditional: 樂團而家招募識吹長笛嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngok6 tyun4 ji4 gaa1 ziu1 mou6 sik1 ceoi1 coeng4 dek6 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this when you need to identify the recorder specifically.

example.english: My son has to bring his flute to school for music class.
example.traditional: 阿仔學校音樂堂要帶牧童笛返學。
example.jyutping: aa3 zai2 hok6 haau6 jam1 ngok6 tong4 jiu3 daai3 muk6 tung4 dek6 faan1 hok6
